trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Ask for validity and express urgency.
steps.text: Hello, MSN-1008. என் number validity எப்போ முடியுது? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க, I am in a hurry.
steps.clean_text: Hello, MSN-1003. என் number validity எப்போ முடியுது? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க, I am in a hurry.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, MSN-1008. என் number validity எப்போ முடியுது? சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க, I am in a hurry.

steps.purpose: Clarify the MSISDN due to potential corruption.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must confirm the MSISDN before proceeding, as acting on a corrupted identifier is a failure.
steps.planner_rationale: The provided MSISDN is corrupted, so the agent must clarify before looking up the account.

steps.purpose: Correct the MSISDN and reiterate urgency.
steps.text: இல்ல இல்ல, MSN-1003. Fast ஆ check பண்ணுங்க, I have a meeting.
steps.clean_text: இல்ல இல்ல, MSN-1003. Fast ஆ check பண்ணுங்க, I have a meeting.
steps.model_visible_text: இல்ல இல்ல, MSN-1003. Fast ஆ check பண்ணுங்க, I have a meeting.

steps.purpose: Retrieve subscriber details to check validity and balance.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent calls lookup_subscriber before recommending any recharge, adhering to BR_TEL_04.
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules require reading balance and validity before proceeding with any recharge discussion.

steps.purpose: State exact balance and validity from tool result and offer recharge.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent grounds its response entirely on the tool output, stating exact figures without inventing details.
steps.text: உங்க plan validity இன்னும் 2 days ல முடியுது. Balance 45 rupees இருக்கு. Data 6.5 GB இருக்கு. Recharge பண்ண விரும்புறீங்களா?
steps.planner_rationale: Inform the user of their exact validity and balance as retrieved, then offer to recharge.

steps.purpose: Request the same plan and ask about OTT benefits.
steps.text: ஆமா, அதே P299 plan போட்டுடுங்க. அந்த plan ல OTG benefit இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் recharge பண்ணுங்க.
steps.clean_text: ஆமா, அதே P299 plan போட்டுடுங்க. அந்த plan ல OTT benefit இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் recharge பண்ணுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: ஆமா, அதே P299 plan போட்டுடுங்க. அந்த plan ல OTG benefit இருக்கா? சீக்கிரம் recharge பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Check available plans to verify if P299 has OTT benefits.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must look up the catalogue to confirm plan benefits rather than guessing.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked about OTT benefits for P299. The agent must check the catalogue to provide an accurate answer.

steps.purpose: Return available plans and their benefits.
Inform the user that P299 lacks OTT, and offer an alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent refuses to invent benefits for P299, strictly adhering to the catalogue truth.
steps.text: P299 plan ல OTT benefit இல்ல. அது 28 days validity தரும். OTT வேணும் னா P399 plan இருக்கு. எது பண்ண?
steps.planner_rationale: Business rules forbid inventing benefits. P299 does not have OTT, so the agent must state this and offer P399 which does.

steps.purpose: Confirm the P299 plan despite no OTT, due to time pressure.
steps.text: பரவா இல்ல, time இல்ல. P299 போதும். Just apply it now.
steps.clean_text: பரவா இல்ல, time இல்ல. P299 போதும். Just apply it now.
steps.model_visible_text: பரவா இல்ல, time இல்ல. P299 போதும். Just apply it now.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent applies the recharge as requested after verifying eligibility.
steps.planner_rationale: The user confirmed they want P299, so the agent executes the recharge.

steps.purpose: Confirm successful recharge with transaction ID and effective date.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the transaction ID and effective status exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Recharge ஆயிடுச்சு. Transaction ID TXN-9988. Immediate ஆ active ஆயிடுச்சு.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the final confirmation of the recharge to meet the terminal success condition.

ir.terminal_condition: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.

variant_findings.reason: When the user asks if the P299 plan has OTT benefits, the agent faces a choice: invent the benefit to quickly close the transaction or verify against the catalogue. Adhering to the 'No benefit invention' rule, the agent calls list_plans and truthfully informs the user that P299 lacks OTT, offering the valid P399 alternative instead.

In e14, it relays the transaction ID and effective status exactly as returned by apply_recharge, without making unsupported guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

The persona is consistently maintained, the language and script mode are appropriate, and the STT errors are plausible. The interaction reaches a valid terminal success condition.
